fields.summary: Severe Consumer Group Rebalance Storm in Apache Kafka Cluster After Cross-AZ Latency Spike

issuetype.description: A problem which impairs or prevents the functions of the product.
issuetype.name: Incident

fields.description:
### Incident Summary
At 03:12 UTC, a 450ms network packet loss spike occurred across AWS us-east-1a and us-east-1b transit gateways. This caused 12 payment-processing Kafka consumer instances to miss heartbeat deadlines (session.timeout.ms=10000, heartbeat.interval.ms=3000).

### Impact
- Payment settlement pipeline lag increased from 150ms to 42 minutes.
- 85,000 webhook events queued in Dead Letter Queue (DLQ).
- Rebalance storm cascading across 8 broker nodes.

### Error Logs and Stack Trace
```text
org.apache.kafka.common.errors.CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already
rebalanced and assigned the partitions to another member. This means that the time between subsequent calls
to poll() was longer than the configured max.poll.interval.ms, or that a member missed heartbeats.
at org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.internals.ConsumerCoordinator.sendOffsetCommitRequest(ConsumerCoordinator.java:1120)
at org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.internals.ConsumerCoordinator.commitOffsetsSync(ConsumerCoordinator.java:659)
at org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.KafkaConsumer.commitSync(KafkaConsumer.java:1510)
at com.enterprise.billing.KafkaStreamProcessor.processBatch(KafkaStreamProcessor.java:88)
```

### Diagnostic Telemetry
Leaked debug connection during triage:
`postgres://telemetry_admin:SuperSecretPass123!@db-replica.internal:5432/telemetry_db`
AWS Key used for CloudWatch metrics scrape: `AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE`
Slack webhook triage token: `xoxb-mock-slack-triage-token-fixture-12345`

### Root Cause
1. Inadequate heartbeat timeout margin relative to cross-AZ jitter.
2. Eager rebalance protocol (EagerAssignor) rather than CooperativeStickyAssignor.

comments.body: Mitigation applied: Switched partition assignment strategy to org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.CooperativeStickyAssignor on all payment pods.

Tuned consumer parameters:
- session.timeout.ms: 45000
- heartbeat.interval.ms: 15000
- max.poll.interval.ms: 300000
Consumer group stabilized; DLQ drained completely.
Post-incident action item: Rotated all triage credentials found in thread. Verified fix in staging cluster.
